facts.text: Testing: strict red-green TDD may be the wrong model for agents; lean toward Ousterhout instead
Outcome-driven development instead of spec (or anything else) driving the work
Agentic loops and subagents have not worked well (scout is ok); prefers short sessions: small bounded slices for implementation, or a bigger one for architecture/planning
A1: split strategic vs tactical work by session type (planning vs slice) in ladder.md
A2: four Ousterhout design rules in standards.md (pull complexity down, split flag/mode params, no pass-through functions, define errors out of existence)
A3: ladder rung 5 'least code' becomes 'simplest code: fewest concepts, not fewest lines'
A4: separate what from how/when (no scheduling, retries or caching inside business logic)
A5: design it twice in /plan (two sketches for a new or changed interface)
A6: (No) interface comments written before the code / comments-first
B1: red-first only for bugs; new behaviour tested through the interface after it is settled (replace 'TDD enforced')
B2: expected values come from the requirement, never from running the code under test
B3: break-it check in /review: break the covered code once and confirm each new test fails
B4: slice-check script (tests green, test/assertion count not lower, no skip/only, diff within declared files), optional pre-commit
B5: (Maybe) opt-in mutation testing (Stryker/mutmut) on changed files in /review
B6: (No) TDD-guard hook blocking edits until a failing test exists
C1: outcome card (outcome, done-when, interface, mechanism, out) as the one unit of work, replacing the Goal block and spec-contract
C2: done-when rule at the top of persona-core: state the check before acting; done means ran it and showed output
C3: rewrite /plan for two modes (planning and slice), removing the auto section, dispatch and rework
C4: delete spec-contract.md
C5: slice-session start rule in /plan 'go': run done-when checks red, work, green, slice-check, report
C6: shorten /handoff by default; keep the 12-section form as /handoff full
C7: (Maybe) cut /where to three rungs (target, slice, this)
D1: cut the Recommendations block in persona-core to two lines
D2: fix the CLAUDE.md contradiction between 'teach concepts/explain why' and 'explain only when asked'
D3: remove duplicate rules in Replies
D4: scout exception: read it yourself when the content itself is the subject
D5: (Maybe) fewer coined labels (rungs, sensors, effort, beyond)
E1: take worker/auto protocol out of persona-pi.md (and ops.md, slice/auto branch prefixes)
E2: (Maybe) move the review checklist from ops.md to review.md, gated by an eval
E3: prompt order: judgment, done-when and scope first, ladder last
E4: (No) shrinking AGENTS.md for tokens
F1: retire auto mode (auto-run.ts, auto-slice, auto-guard, hooks, orch eval role)
F2: retire --rw workers once B4 has landed
F3: keep scout --review as an on-demand second reviewer for a slice
F4: at the compaction cap start a new session instead of compacting (handoff and start fresh; optionally lower the cap to ~120k)
F5: align the Claude Code delta: drop the concurrent-subagents rule; read-only subagents, one writer
F6: (Maybe) drop health-footer.ts
F7: (No) Ralph loops, parallel writers, spec kits
G1: clean up memory.md (too big; move or delete the dotfiles and pi scopes)
G2: ~200-character bullet cap in /memory plus a verify.sh line-cap check
G3: (Maybe) idle cache rebuilds / longer cache TTL
H1: split DESIGN.md into current decisions and a dated LOG.md
H2: commit the uncommitted fragment/prompt edits first so the baseline is in git; fix stale claude-delta.md:23
H3: prose checks in verify.sh (agents named exist, memory line cap, no mention of removed features)
I1: before/after agent-eval gate for the whole change set (review, plan, scout roles, cold-start probe)
I2: (Maybe) a slice eval role to replace orch
G1 (the memory.md clean-up) is the item that was dropped
